name: cocos-creator
description: Develop Cocos Creator projects and build Web or mini-game artifacts with the local editor.

interface.shortDescription: Develop Cocos games and build platform artifacts.
interface.longDescription: Use a local Cocos Creator installation to edit TypeScript, scenes, and assets and build Web, WeChat, or Douyin artifacts. The initial workflow targets Creator 3.8 LTS and preserves each project's editor version. Enable a platform plugin for mini-game integration and device checks. Disabled by default; engine and device validation remain part of Beta acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this Cocos Creator project's version and build setup.
Implement a tap counter in this Cocos project and build a local preview.
